map.输入溶质物质的量与溶剂质量（kg），按 b=n/m 计算质量摩尔浓度，该浓度不受: Enter moles of solute and solvent mass (kg) to compute molality by b = n/m; this concentration is unaffected by temperature and is often used for colligative properties and thermodynamic calculations.
map.质量摩尔浓度 = 溶质物质的量 / 溶剂质量(kg)，不受温度影响。: Molality = moles of solute / solvent mass (kg), unaffected by temperature.
map.冰点降低：由 b 与 Kf 算 ΔTf，估溶液冰点。: Freezing point depression: compute dTf from b and Kf to estimate the solution's freezing point.
map.配制基准：称溶质+溶剂质量得 b，不受体积温度影响。: Preparation basis: weigh solute plus solvent mass to get b, unaffected by temperature-driven volume change.
map.渗透压强：由 b 算渗透压 π=bRT。: Osmotic pressure: compute pi = bRT from b.
map.0.1 mol 溶质溶于 0.5 kg 水演练: 0.1 mol solute dissolved in 0.5 kg water exercise
map.：输入 n=0.1 mol、溶剂 0.5 kg，工具输出 b=0.20 mol/: : entering n = 0.1 mol in 0.5 kg solvent makes the tool output b = 0.20 mol/kg and notes that solvent mass excludes the solute.
map.由各组分的物质的量求摩尔分数: Mole fraction from the amount of substance of each component
map.和摩尔浓度区别？: How does it differ from molarity?
map.molality 用溶剂质量（不受温度体积变），molarity 用溶液体积。: Molality uses solvent mass (unaffected by temperature-driven volume change), while molarity uses solution volume.
map.为什么依数性用 b？: Why do colligative properties use b?
map.依数性只与粒子数/溶剂质量有关，b 更稳。: Colligative properties depend only on particle number per solvent mass, so b is more stable.
map.溶剂质量含溶质吗？: Does solvent mass include the solute?
map.不含，是纯溶剂质量；溶液质量=溶剂+溶质。: No, it is the pure solvent mass; solution mass = solvent + solute.
